text:
Dear Sir or Madam,

I am writing to enquire about hiring the 1975 Orsini Veloce for my sister's wedding day. We would like to collect the vehicle on 11th April 2027 at 13:00 and return it on Tuesday 13 April 2027 at 18:00. The vehicle would be collected from your garage. Please find my driving licence attached.

Sincerely,
Hugo Larkmoor
